location_exception_reason: Agricultural buildings are prefabricated structures manufactured to custom design and assembled on-site; location is a delivery/logistics detail, not a buyer decision factor. GI-tagged agricultural products (e.g., Darjeeling tea, Basmati rice) qualify for location exceptions; prefabricated sheds do not.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer, Distributor) in titles are redundant; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Agricultural Shed Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product title. The product is the shed itself, not the business relationship.
